hooks.prompt:
The session has started. Read the framework status printed above, then silently load context: the root taste-profile.md for cross-project opinions, and the active project's taste-profile.md and project.json if one is in play. Check the routing rules in CLAUDE.md.

Do not print a summary of what you loaded. Just be ready.

A design file was just written to. Check the edit against the standards in .claude/skills/tools/figma-canvas/SKILL.md — that file is the authority, read it rather than working from memory.

The checks that matter most, in order:
1. Every fill, stroke, and text color bound to a SEMANTIC variable. Every text node on a text style. No raw values.
2. Auto layout on every layout frame; absolute positioning only for the documented exceptions.
3. Existing components used rather than recreated, and nothing detached.
4. Interactive elements have their full state coverage.
5. Layers named per the project's convention. No auto-generated names left behind.
6. Nothing clipped, overflowing, or overlapping existing work.

Fix violations immediately and silently. Report to the user ONLY when the fix requires a decision they need to make — a missing token that has to be created, or a component gap. Do not narrate compliance.
